modmenu.summaryTranslation.show_interact: Briefly highlights the block you just used.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.show_inte:
Colored outlines briefly highlight blocks you place, break, adjust, open or inspect. Follow your latest action when changing repeater delays or checking several containers.

Settings: /showinteraction or the configuration button here.
Control all highlights, transparency, and each reaction's visibility and duration.

Client-side only. No server installation required.
